name: Last War
storyline:
Storyline:
A global zombie infestation has ravaged the world, turning countless humans into the undead.
Players start as a survivor with the primary goal of retaining their humanity and outliving the apocalypse.
The game features seasons, with Season 1 focusing on Dr. Noah's virus and the rise of the Doom Legion and Lady in Red (later Crimson Queen).
Season 2 introduces a Polar Storm scenario, where players must survive in a harsh, frozen environment under the control of Emperor Boreas.
Rival factions compete for scarce resources in the polar region.
summary: Partner with players from all over the globe to battle the zombies. Stay alert – alliances are complex, and not every survivor you encounter is friendly.
